text:
Jana: quick sync — proposing we slim the Optimize toolkit slice for the next sprint: ship MVP eval-triggered alerts + basic quantization recommendations, and defer adaptive batching + cache-eviction heuristics to Sprint N+1. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Liam: +1 on deferring batching. Our immediate constraint is eng capacity and test infra. Need concrete acceptance criteria for eval-alerts though (what constitutes a firing alert, latency SLO, payload).

Jana: sketch ACs below — open to edits:
```
1) Alerting: when an eval suite run crosses a configured threshold (precision drop or rouge delta), system emits an alert within 30s of run completion.
2) Config: per-customer and per-model thresholds configurable via Console/API.
3) Payload: alert includes top 10 failing example IDs, metric diffs, model version, eval-run id, and a short diff summary.
4) UI: customers can ack/close and set snooze.
5) Canary: rollout gated — start with single-customer canary.
```

Matt: SRE note — we need the event schema and retention plan before canary. Propose retention 90d for alert history and 365d for aggregated metrics. Also please add a noise-reduction plan (dedupe window, rate-limit per-customer).

Sophie: FYI Finlytics (large eval-heavy customer) is willing to be the canary if we support per-model thresholds and notify CS before firing. They asked for an opt-in toggle.

Liam: for quantization recommendations (MVP) propose a deterministic rule-based recommender: recommend quantization if measured latency improves >10% and eval-concordance drop <=2%. Output should include expected token throughput uplift and a short risk note. This avoids needing full RL/ML recommender in sprint 1.

Jana: sounds good. Decision summary: ship eval-triggered alerts (MVP) + basic quant recs; defer batching/cache heuristics. Roadmap action items I/O:
- PM: add feature flags and acceptance criteria to the ticket (will do today)
- Eng: implement API + minimal Console UI for canary, include dedupe window and retention hooks
- SRE: provide event schema + retention ops playbook
- CS: onboard Finlytics as canary and coordinate comms

Quick config example for canary toggle:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/feature-flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"ff_optimize_eval_alerts","enabled":true,"targets":["org:finlytics"]}'
```

deploy-bot: feature flag created: ff_optimize_eval_alerts (id: ff-8932) :white_check_mark:

Liam: noted. I'll scope a minimal telemetry pipeline for the next 2 sprints.

Jana: thanks all — I'll update the roadmap doc and move batching to Backlog. :thumbsup:
